  FROM tbl_exam_inventory
  WHERE reading_provider_npi IS NOT NULL AND reading_provider_name_full IS NOT NULL AND reading_provider_name_full LIKE '%,%'

npi_ambiguity AS (
  SELECT npi, count(distinct name_reordered) as distinct_name_cnt FROM npi_all_names GROUP BY npi

designations AS (

datasets.name: ds_first_time_weekly
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT npi, log_date, is_v2, mosaic_version, modality, practice, local, radiologist_name
  FROM edw_prod.bipa_analytics.mosaic_version_exam_detail
  WHERE npi IS NOT NULL
    AND radiologist_name NOT IN ('Unknown', 'Unknown, Unknown', 'Not Applicable, Not Applicable')
    AND (size(:filter_practices) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_practices, practice))
    AND (size(:filter_modalities) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_modalities, modality))
    AND (size(:filter_versions) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_versions, mosaic_version))
    AND (size(:filter_locals) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_locals, local))
    AND (size(:filter_radiologists) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_radiologists, radiologist_name))
    AND (size(:excluded_practices) = 0 OR NOT array_contains(:excluded_practices, practice))
    AND log_date BETWEEN :filter_date_range.min AND :filter_date_range.max
),
npi_mosaic_exams AS (
  SELECT npi,
    COUNT(*) as total_exams,
    SUM(is_v2) as total_v2_exams,
    MIN(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 2.0' THEN log_date END) as first_v2_date
  FROM base
  GROUP BY npi
),
first_timers AS (
  SELECT npi, first_v2_date,
    total_v2_exams * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_exams, 0) as pct_v2
  FROM npi_mosaic_exams
  WHERE first_v2_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', first_v2_date) as week_start,
  CASE
    WHEN pct_v2 < 0.2 THEN '<20%'
    WHEN pct_v2 <= 0.8 THEN '20-80%'
    ELSE '>80%'
  END as pct_bucket,
  COUNT(*) as first_time_users
FROM first_timers
GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_first_time_table
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT npi, log_date, is_v2, mosaic_version, modality, practice, local, radiologist_name
  FROM edw_prod.bipa_analytics.mosaic_version_exam_detail
  WHERE npi IS NOT NULL
    AND radiologist_name NOT IN ('Unknown', 'Unknown, Unknown', 'Not Applicable, Not Applicable')
    AND (size(:filter_practices) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_practices, practice))
    AND (size(:filter_modalities) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_modalities, modality))
    AND (size(:filter_versions) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_versions, mosaic_version))
    AND (size(:filter_locals) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_locals, local))
    AND (size(:filter_radiologists) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_radiologists, radiologist_name))
    AND (size(:excluded_practices) = 0 OR NOT array_contains(:excluded_practices, practice))
),
npi_overall AS (
  SELECT npi,
    SUM(is_v2) as total_v2_exams,
    MIN(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 2.0' THEN log_date END) as first_v2_date,
    MAX_BY(radiologist_name, log_date) as radiologist_name,
    MAX_BY(practice, log_date) as practice,
    MAX_BY(local, log_date) as local
  FROM base
  GROUP BY npi
),
l30d AS (
  SELECT npi,
    COUNT(*) as total_exams_l30d,
    SUM(is_v2) as v2_exams_l30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN modality = 'MG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mg_exams_l30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN modality = 'CT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ct_exams_l30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN modality = 'US' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as us_exams_l30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN modality = 'MR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mr_exams_l30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN modality = 'CR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cr_exams_l30d
  FROM base
  WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30)
  GROUP BY npi
)
SELECT
  o.local, o.practice, o.radiologist_name,
  o.first_v2_date,
  o.total_v2_exams as total_v2_exams_to_date,
  l.v2_exams_l30d * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.total_exams_l30d, 0) as pct_v2_l30d,
  l.mg_exams_l30d * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.total_exams_l30d, 0) as pct_mg_l30d,
  l.ct_exams_l30d * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.total_exams_l30d, 0) as pct_ct_l30d,
  l.us_exams_l30d * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.total_exams_l30d, 0) as pct_us_l30d,
  l.mr_exams_l30d * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.total_exams_l30d, 0) as pct_mr_l30d,
  l.cr_exams_l30d * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.total_exams_l30d, 0) as pct_cr_l30d
FROM npi_overall o
LEFT JOIN l30d l ON o.npi = l.npi
WHERE o.first_v2_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30)

datasets.name: ds_eff_top_procedure
queryLines:
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pct_change DESC) as rank,
  procedure_name,
  exams,
  rads,
  pct_change
FROM (
  SELECT procedure_name,
    SUM(exam_count) as exams,
    COUNT(DISTINCT physician_npi) as rads,
    (SUM(total_tbwu) / NULLIF(SUM(total_time_sec)/60.0, 0) - SUM(weighted_baseline_contrib) / NULLIF(SUM(total_time_sec), 0))
    / NULLIF(SUM(weighted_baseline_contrib) / NULLIF(SUM(total_time_sec), 0), 0) AS pct_change
  FROM edw_prod.bipa_analytics.mosaic_efficiency_detail
  WHERE (size(:filter_practices) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_practices, practice))
    AND (size(:filter_modalities) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_modalities, modality))
    AND (size(:filter_versions) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_versions, mosaic_version))
    AND (size(:filter_locals) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_locals, local))
    AND (size(:filter_radiologists) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_radiologists, radiologist_name))
    AND (size(:excluded_practices) = 0 OR NOT array_contains(:excluded_practices, practice))
    AND mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 2.0'
  GROUP BY procedure_name
  HAVING SUM(exam_count) >= 30
)
ORDER BY pct_change DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ds_eff_by_modality_agg
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT modality, mosaic_version,
    SUM(exam_count) as exams,
    COUNT(DISTINCT physician_npi) as rads,
    (SUM(total_tbwu) / NULLIF(SUM(total_time_sec)/60.0, 0) - SUM(weighted_baseline_contrib) / NULLIF(SUM(total_time_sec), 0))
    / NULLIF(SUM(weighted_baseline_contrib) / NULLIF(SUM(total_time_sec), 0), 0) AS pct_change
  FROM edw_prod.bipa_analytics.mosaic_efficiency_detail
  WHERE (size(:filter_practices) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_practices, practice))
    AND (size(:filter_modalities) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_modalities, modality))
    AND (size(:filter_versions) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_versions, mosaic_version))
    AND (size(:filter_locals) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_locals, local))
    AND (size(:filter_radiologists) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_radiologists, radiologist_name))
    AND (size(:excluded_practices) = 0 OR NOT array_contains(:excluded_practices, practice))
  GROUP BY modality, mosaic_version
)
SELECT
  modality,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 1.0' THEN exams END), 0) as exams_v1,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 2.0' THEN exams END), 0) as exams_v2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 1.0' THEN pct_change END) as gain_v1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 2.0' THEN pct_change END) as gain_v2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 2.0' THEN pct_change END) - MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 1.0' THEN pct_change END) as gap,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 2.0' THEN pct_change END) - MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 1.0' THEN pct_change END) >= 0 THEN 'Mosaic 2.0 Ahead' ELSE 'Mosaic 1.0 Ahead' END as gap_direction
FROM base
GROUP BY modality
ORDER BY exams_v1 + exams_v2 DESC

datasets.name: ds_eff_by_practice_agg
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT practice, mosaic_version,
    SUM(exam_count) as exams,
    COUNT(DISTINCT physician_npi) as rads,
    (SUM(total_tbwu) / NULLIF(SUM(total_time_sec)/60.0, 0) - SUM(weighted_baseline_contrib) / NULLIF(SUM(total_time_sec), 0))
    / NULLIF(SUM(weighted_baseline_contrib) / NULLIF(SUM(total_time_sec), 0), 0) AS pct_change
  FROM edw_prod.bipa_analytics.mosaic_efficiency_detail
  WHERE (size(:filter_practices) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_practices, practice))
    AND (size(:filter_modalities) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_modalities, modality))
    AND (size(:filter_versions) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_versions, mosaic_version))
    AND (size(:filter_locals) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_locals, local))
    AND (size(:filter_radiologists) = 0 OR array_contains(:filter_radiologists, radiologist_name))
    AND (size(:excluded_practices) = 0 OR NOT array_contains(:excluded_practices, practice))
  GROUP BY practice, mosaic_version
)
SELECT
  practice,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 1.0' THEN exams END), 0) as exams_v1,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 2.0' THEN exams END), 0) as exams_v2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 1.0' THEN pct_change END) as gain_v1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 2.0' THEN pct_change END) as gain_v2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 2.0' THEN pct_change END) - MAX(CASE WHEN mosaic_version = 'Mosaic 1.0' THEN pct_change END) as gap
FROM base
GROUP BY practice
HAVING exams_v1 + exams_v2 >= 30
ORDER BY exams_v1 + exams_v2 DESC

Leadership list is matched by name against the provider roster, with known nickname variants manually verified and added.*

## Notes
